question:
Select the option that can be used as a one - word substitute for the given group of words.

Animal living both on land and water.
solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 2** i.e. **Amphibian**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word **"Amphibian"** refers to animals that can live both on land and in water. (जल और थल दोनों में रहनेवाला जीव)

 
 
• **Example: **Frogs and salamanders are examples of amphibians.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Amphibian**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options with their meanings:

 
• **Marine** (समुद्री): Relating to the sea; existing in or produced by the sea.

 
 
• **Example: **Whales and sharks are marine creatures.
 
 
 
• **Arboreal** (वृक्षों में रहने वाला): Living in trees.
 
 
• **Example: **Many monkeys and birds are arboreal animals.
 
 
 
• **Terrestrial** (स्थलीय): Relating to the earth or land; living or growing on land.
 
 
• **Example: **Lions and elephants are terrestrial animals.
